resources.string: مستقبل RoadLink
A generic Android head-unit receiver with USB and wireless connection paths. Configure authentication, then open the receiver.
Development preview: receiver code is included. No vehicle or iPhone has been tested by this fork yet.

استخدام عتاد مصادقة USB/CH341

A CH341 USB bridge alone is insufficient: it must connect to a compatible authentication coprocessor. The receiver will request USB access and report missing hardware. No hardware has been tested by this fork.
إزالة ملفات المصادقة المستوردة
Remove the local authentication files? Local authentication will need to be configured again. Running receiver sessions must be disconnected first.
فتح المستقبل
A matching local key and certificate do not establish Apple authorization or iPhone acceptance. USB, Wi-Fi, video, touch and audio require separate device tests.

Derived from DiPlay and xcertplay; UI portions derive from DiAuto. Original authors and GPL/AGPL notices are preserved in the repository and receiver About page. No Apple or vehicle-maker endorsement.
